============================================================================
OmniBuf-ES Benchmark Suite (Node.js v26.5.0 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf |    950 ns | 1,052,791 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| protobufjs |   1388 ns | 720,266 | 341 | 1.46x slower |
| @bufbuild/protobuf (protobuf-es) |   2467 ns | 405,326 | 341 | 2.60x slower |
| google-protobuf |   5072 ns | 197,170 | 341 | 5.34x slower |
| @msgpack/msgpack |   3476 ns | 287,712 | 622 | 3.66x slower |
| JSON |   1793 ns | 557,840 | 791 | 1.89x slower |
